verdict.rationale: Real-time multi-session updates are a fair axis for a collaborative board tool like Trello, but nothing in the evidence says teammates' changes appear live without refreshing. The nearest items are calendar sync, REST webhooks (a developer building block) and community praise for a 'responsive UI', and none of these is about live propagation of collaborators' edits.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
